data.name: Hotel Director
data.address: Av Vitacura 3600, 8320000 Vitacura, Región Metropolitana, Chile
data.description:
On a bustling tree-lined street, this low-key hotel is 2 km from the nearest metro station and 16 minutes' walk from the walking trails at Parque Bicentenario. It's 11 km from the shops in the city center.
Laid-back rooms with flat-screen TVs and free Wi-Fi, as well as minibars and safes. Suites add separate living rooms. Room service is available. Kids age 12 and under stay at no charge with their parents.
Parking is complimentary. There's a casual international restaurant with a bar and outdoor seating. Other amenities include an outdoor pool and a sundeck, plus a gym and a sauna. Meeting space is offered.
